records.title: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis Disease Activity Module

records.title: Vaccination Smart Notification Engine
records.focused_finding: Delivery owns notifications; determining due, overdue or catch-up status depends on separately versioned immunization rules and patient context.

records.title: Vaccine Allergy Registry
records.main_purpose: Maintains structured records of suspected and confirmed vaccine allergies.
records.focused_finding: Preserve suspected versus confirmed reaction, product, batch, dose, timing and specialist attribution; do not convert uncertainty to absence.

records.title: Vaccine Component Allergy Cross-Check Engine
records.main_purpose: Cross-checks documented allergies against vaccine components.
records.focused_finding: Ingredient, excipient, residual and packaging evidence remain distinct; a potential conflict requests review and must not automatically refuse vaccination.

records.title: Privacy-Preserving Vaccine Exemption Verification Module
records.main_purpose: Allows authorized third parties to verify exemption status without unnecessary disclosure.
records.focused_finding: Verify a scoped exemption claim with issuer and expiry while withholding diagnosis; token verification must not imply clinical validity or legal acceptance.

records.title: Vaccine Certificate QR Verification Module
records.focused_finding: Certificate and issuer verification do not authorize access to underlying records; preserve separate authorization and expiry checks.

records.title: Vaccination Evidence Provenance Engine
records.main_purpose: Maintains evidence provenance for vaccination rules.
records.focused_finding: Rule evidence must retain authority, document, version, dates, jurisdiction and supersession; unsupported generated rules cannot enter production logic.

records.title: Vaccination AI Decision Support Module
records.focused_finding: Preserve clinician-facing scope and the explicit prohibition on autonomous exemption or contraindication certification.

records.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity Screening & Treatment Module
records.main_purpose: Coordinate screening, classification, treatment and long-term follow-up of retinopathy of prematurity.
records.focused_finding: Retain gestational/birth-weight context, stage/zone and treatment pathways. Share a prospective ophthalmic profile with 4965 only after retaining both source bodies and distinct follow-up requirements.

records.title: Adolescent Menstrual Health & Digital Cycle Record Module
records.main_purpose: Provide structured longitudinal documentation of menstrual health.
records.focused_finding: Cycle recording is optional; age-aware confidential access cannot be replaced by blanket guardian visibility.

records.title: Adolescent Abnormal Uterine Bleeding & Menorrhagia Module
records.main_purpose: Coordinate assessment of abnormal or clinically significant menstrual bleeding in adolescents.
records.focused_finding: Bleeding, anemia and hemodynamic escalation requirements need qualified review; no threshold or treatment rule is supplied by this review.

records.title: Adolescent Dysmenorrhea & Menstrual Pain Management Module
records.main_purpose: Provide longitudinal evaluation of menstrual pain and associated functional impairment.
records.focused_finding: Preserve school/activity impact and secondary-cause assessment, not only pain intensity.

records.title: Adolescent Endometriosis & Chronic Pelvic Pain Module
records.main_purpose: Coordinate multidisciplinary assessment and longitudinal management of suspected or confirmed adolescent endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain.
records.focused_finding: Retain suspected and confirmed disease separately and the explicit principle that symptom burden remains visible despite limited objective findings.

records.title: Adolescent Polycystic Ovary & Hyperandrogenism Clinical Module
records.main_purpose: Support careful longitudinal evaluation of adolescent hyperandrogenic and polycystic ovary-related clinical presentations.
records.focused_finding: Preserve adolescent-specific developmental and diagnostic safeguards against premature classification.

records.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity Screening & Longitudinal Care Module
records.main_purpose: Coordinate neonatal retinal screening, treatment and long-term visual follow-up for infants at risk of retinopathy of prematurity.
records.focused_finding: Overlap candidate with 4734; retain oxygen/respiratory context, post-treatment surveillance, refractive outcome and due/overdue follow-up rather than collapsing by title.
